observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (4927 x 4368) blurred 3x3, in nine tiles at full size with a 0.02 grid and sixteen closer crops at 0.01, against a reference render of the cabin from about the right place (not the photo's camera: the photo has none yet)
covers: the rear of the compartment looking aft along the axis: the roof's transverse beam and the turret's base in its elliptical opening (ring, boot, drive, drums), the rear bulkhead with its ledge, rounded right corner, door and lower flap, both blue lamps, the 0096-9M2 whole with its lid, plugs, cables and plinth, GA-3 with its tray and rail, the right wall's aft corner (SP-3M-2, the bent tube, its bracket, T-key, first-aid box, wheel-arch housing), the left wall's SL-3M, post, tables, keys and gauge panel, the floor plinths and the folded seats with bags in the foreground
notes: The cabinet stands square to the bulkhead: the face's top and bottom edges are level and of one length, its sides vertical and of one height, both side faces show as thin strips (the right one with louvres and a red plate), so it is not turned 38 degrees (within a few degrees). The face is about 1.1 times as tall as wide and fills the whole front under a top housing. The bulkhead's blue lamp (d50) sits hard by the bulkhead's right-hand corner, outboard of the door's right edge by about half a door-rib's length and level with the door's top, under the ledge; the cabin has it 0.31 m right of the centreline near the roof. A second, caged blue lamp (d24) is on the right wall at the top of the corner aft of SP-2M2: it is g092-a's d22, which belongs on lamp.blue_post_right, not lamp.blue. The observation's 'curved lined post' (frame.post_sp2m_sp3m) is g092-a's bent tube (new.frame.strut_rear_right, d33 here); the post between SP-2M2 and SP-3M-2 is the white channel at the frame's left edge (d21). Seats: the view hides the cabin's raised operators' seats; their folded frames here are I5's (not_built).
